item.title: Initial Setup of Pop!_OS
item.description: Environment Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS Overview Pop!_OS, an Ubuntu-based Linux desktop, seems to be getting popular lately, so I gave it a try. Initial Setup Steps Installing the OS Download the installer from the official page and write it to a USB drive as boot media. Download page Boot the PC from the USB drive you created and install the OS.
